# SwiftAISDK documentation

SwiftAISDK is a SwiftPM port of the provider-facing Vercel AI SDK.

## LLM-readable pages
- [Introduction](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/index.txt): Learn what SwiftAISDK is and where to start.
- [Components](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/components.txt): Generated component map for SwiftAISDK public APIs.
- [Audio](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/components/audio.txt): Public SwiftAISDK APIs for audio.
- [Chat and UI messages](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/components/chat-and-ui-messages.txt): Public SwiftAISDK APIs for chat and ui messages.
- [Core runtime](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/components/core-runtime.txt): Public SwiftAISDK APIs for core runtime.
- [Errors](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/components/errors.txt): Public SwiftAISDK APIs for errors.
- [MCP](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/components/mcp.txt): Public SwiftAISDK APIs for mcp.
- [Media](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/components/media.txt): Public SwiftAISDK APIs for media.
- [Middleware](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/components/middleware.txt): Public SwiftAISDK APIs for middleware.
- [Provider models](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/components/provider-models.txt): Public SwiftAISDK APIs for provider models.
- [Providers](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/components/providers.txt): Public SwiftAISDK APIs for providers.
- [Structured output](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/components/structured-output.txt): Public SwiftAISDK APIs for structured output.
- [Telemetry](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/components/telemetry.txt): Public SwiftAISDK APIs for telemetry.
- [Tools](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/components/tools.txt): Public SwiftAISDK APIs for tools.
- [Video and reranking](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/components/video-and-reranking.txt): Public SwiftAISDK APIs for video and reranking.
- [MCP events](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/cookbook/mcp-events.txt): Receive authenticated MCP event webhooks with durable subscription state or delegate subscription management to an adapter.
- [MCP tools](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/cookbook/mcp-tools.txt): Discover MCP tools and pass them to a language model.
- [Durable batches](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/core/batch-text.txt): Run provider-owned text and image batches and resume their lifecycle.
- [Decision](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/core/decide.txt): Ask typed Choice, Score, Boolean, and image Box questions about ordered text, JSON, and file evidence.
- [Dubbing](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/core/dubbing.txt): Create and inspect provider dubbing jobs.
- [Embeddings](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/core/embeddings.txt): Convert text into vectors for search, clustering, and retrieval.
- [Error handling](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/core/error-handling.txt): Handle validation, provider, retry, timeout, abort, and output errors.
- [Evaluation](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/core/evaluate.txt): Evaluate shared JSON state with typed Choice, Score, and Boolean questions.
- [Files](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/core/files.txt): Upload, inspect, stream, and delete provider-managed files.
- [Generate audio](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/core/generate-audio.txt): Generate provider audio that is not speech.
- [Generate image](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/core/generate-image.txt): Create or edit images with an image model.
- [Generate speech](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/core/generate-speech.txt): Convert text into audio with a speech model.
- [Generate text](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/core/generate-text.txt): Use a language model for one-shot text generation.
- [Generate video](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/core/generate-video.txt): Create video clips with a video model.
- [Realtime sessions](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/core/realtime.txt): Run bidirectional text, audio, and tool sessions over a provider Realtime V4 model.
- [Rerank](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/core/rerank.txt): Score and reorder documents for a query.
- [Stream speech](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/core/stream-speech.txt): Synthesize audio incrementally from complete or streaming text.
- [Stream text](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/core/stream-text.txt): Consume language model output as an async sequence.
- [Structured output](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/core/structured-output.txt): Generate Decodable Swift values from JSON output.
- [Telemetry](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/core/telemetry.txt): Record provider calls, retries, streams, tool execution, usage, and metadata.
- [Tools](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/core/tools.txt): Let a language model call typed Swift tools.
- [Transcribe audio](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/core/transcribe.txt): Convert audio bytes into text with a transcription model.
- [Transform audio](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/core/transform-audio.txt): Transform existing audio through provider-native audio tools.
- [Install](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/getting-started/install.txt): Add SwiftAISDK to a SwiftPM package and configure credentials.
- [Migrate to 3.0](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/getting-started/migrating-to-3.txt): Choose independent Swift packages or keep the complete compatibility API.
- [Quickstart](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/getting-started/quickstart.txt): Generate text with a provider and model.
- [Provider matrix](https://swiftaisdk.github.io/SwiftAISDK/llms/providers.txt): Generated provider capability overview for SwiftAISDK.
